selection: Same ten retained contexts and all search frames; no control/cohort substitutions.
pose_sampling: At initialization8 frames both scales; subsequently every2 source frames relative to initialization, only where retained native far candidates exist. Unsampled frames receive zero extra cost, not interpolated features.
association_rule: Add0.8*max(0,min_far_team_torso_distance-min_near_or_initial_unselected_torso_distance-0.04) to each native far observation cost. Both far IDs share the same extra cost. No color-based rejection; missing pose/evidence has zero extra cost.
anchor_rule: Retained initialization8 source frames, exact selected native seed IDs. One-to-one pose correspondence IoU>=0.5. Far anchors from far_context, near anchors from court. Initial unselected eligible far-context poses are negative exemplars only when overlap<0.1 with every selected native seed at initialization.
additional_ablation: Second mode also prevents the two chosen native candidates from using the same per-frame pose. It neither requires a pose nor substitutes pose coordinates.
numeric_parameters: Existing weights/margins reused, no sweep. Soft cost is an engineering term, not calibrated identity confidence.
baseline_verification: Replay copied solver with zero extra cost and exclusivity disabled for all ten cases; require exact native paths and cost.
observed_positions: Only original native detection coordinates exported; ankle/torso estimates stay internal diagnostics. Neither original box bottoms nor model keypoints establish measured ground contact.
